verses.1: If you have been united with Christ, then seek those things that are above. For Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
verses.2: Care for those above; do not care for those on earth.
verses.3: For you must die, and your life will be hidden along with Christ in God.
verses.4: When Christ appears, your life will also be revealed in glory. Then, you too will be revealed with Him in glory.
verses.5: You have destroyed those members of the human body that are related to lust, immorality, impurity, suffering, evil desires, and also excesses such as idolatry.
verses.6: For what reason does God’s anger come upon the children of disobedience?
verses.7: In which of these places also you have ever been involved when you were among them?
verses.8: And now, you also must put away from yourselves all anger, wrath, evilness, slander, and harmful speech.
verses.9: Do not deceive each other. Let go of that old man along with his actions.
verses.10: And they dressed the new building in a manner that resembled its original appearance.
verses.11: Where there is no Greek or Jew, there is circumcision and anal mutilation; barbarians, Scythians, slaves, free people… But in all things, Christ is present.
verses.12: You have been chosen as vessels of God’s love and grace. You are holy and beloved. You possess virtues such as humility, righteousness, and long-suffering.
verses.13: Let us continue to support and help each other, in case anyone might feel resentful towards someone else. Just as the Lord has pleased you, so also should you do the same.
verses.14: And for all of these people, love is the bond that brings perfection.
verses.15: And the peace of Christ will reward you in your hearts, for it is to that place where you were called to go. May you be blessed.
verses.16: The teachings of Christ are to be understood by you in a profound and wise manner. By teaching and exhorting yourselves through songs, hymns, and spiritual songs, you will learn from the Lord within your hearts.
verses.17: And everything you do, whether in speech or in action, all things are done in the name of Lord Jesus. Praise be to God, our Father, through Him.
verses.18: Women, you should submit yourselves to the men, as it is commanded in the Torah.
verses.19: Men, love your wives and do not be angry with them.
verses.20: Children, you must obey your parents in everything. This is indeed a good thing to do as children.
verses.21: Parents, do not spoil your children, so that they will not become disobedient.
verses.22: O servants, obey all the lords of this body completely. Do not act in a way that is contrary to human nature. Instead, act with simplicity of heart, and fear your lord.
verses.23: If you do it, then do it from the heart, not for human purposes or for others.
verses.24: You know that you have been freed from the obligations of inheritance by your lord. You serve your lord Christ.
verses.25: For he will be punished for his wrongdoing; it’s not a matter of being hypocritical.
